en: Sepia-toned sports postcard showing two male long‑distance runners on an athletics track at the finish of a race. The foreground runner, wearing bib number 797 with a light-colored jersey bearing a small emblem, is crossing or about to cross the finish line ahead of a second runner wearing bib number 800. Spectators fill the blurred background stands. A printed caption in Dutch appears beneath the image.
